Subtitle Generator for DaVinci — initial release:

- Quickly generate and sync subtitles for DaVinci Resolve video exports using a cloud processing backend.
- Supports direct video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and more) and automatic 1080p MP4 export with captions.
- 1-click anonymous login provides 100 free credits; setup happens automatically on first use.
- Simple commands for uploading, editing, checking credits, and exporting results.
- Fast processing: most exports complete within 30–90 seconds; real-time status updates and clear error handling included.
